a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building the reserve to 8 first means we're both very likely caught with empty units. So I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than operate. I know that departs from our agreement, which is why I'm telling you now instead of doing it quietly. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me. If I end up with spare cells later, I'll give them back to the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. If the episode continues, I'll give back anything beyond 4 and help operate so you can reach 4 too.
